name: Baited Hook
texts: :rb_energy_1::rb_rune_order:, :rb_exhaust:: Kill a friendly unit. Look at the top 5 cards of your Main Deck. You may banish a unit from among them that has Might up to 1 more than the killed unit and play it, ignoring its cost. Then recycle the rest.
manual: Look at the top 5 cards of your Main Deck.
You may banish a unit from among them that has Might up to 1 more than the killed unit and play it, ignoring its cost.
